patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding create distinct content blocks, often featuring a central headline and supporting content, or a multi-column grid.
A clear typographic hierarchy uses a bold, sans-serif font for prominent headings and a lighter weight for body text, ensuring readability and strong visual emphasis on key messages.
A clean, neutral base palette of white, light gray, and dark gray is punctuated by vibrant, distinct accent colors (green, yellow, red, blue) used for product cards and key interactive elements.

A 'dual sticky' system is employed, with the main navigation bar shrinking and gaining a solid background on scroll, while a secondary informational bar with product benefits appears and sticks to the bottom of the viewport.
Content sections and individual elements within them (e.g., ingredient circles, review cards, partner logos) subtly fade in and slide up as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal effect.
The 'technically, delicious.' section features a unique ingredient breakdown using circular diagrams with percentage values, visually representing the product's composition.

technique_notes: The site employs a responsive grid system for content arrangement, adapting from multi-column layouts on desktop to stacked single-column on smaller screens.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to enhance engagement; elements are initially hidden or partially transparent and then transition into full view with a slight upward motion and fade as their parent section becomes visible in the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes.

The primary navigation bar dynamically adjusts its styling (height, background color) based on scroll position, while a separate informational bar is fixed to the bottom of the screen after an initial scroll threshold, both using JavaScript to toggle classes or inline styles.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger (~2-3x body) than the legible body text, with a clear hierarchy established through size and weight.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card edges, maintaining a clean yet approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact arrangement within content blocks like the ingredient breakdown.

standout: This site stands out with its 'dual sticky' navigation system, featuring both a transforming top nav and a persistent bottom info bar, which effectively maintains key information in view. The clean, scientific aesthetic is enlivened by a vibrant, almost playful product card color palette and a distinctive circular ingredient breakdown section.
